Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You tap the wedge home. The next shoulder against the door will meet wood already ready to give.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One adjacent unattended door, lid or movable obstacle.
Equipment / acquisition
A lever and wedges (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.
Limits
One prepared obstacle at a time; benefit lasts one minute or until used.
Type
Skill / Utility

Prepare the obstacle with your lever and wedges. The next Force roll by you or an ally to open, close or move it gains 2 Boons. Choose the intended task when preparing it.
